responsibility: This is GCC's autoconf input for the gcc/ subdirectory. It defines the host/build/target configuration logic that probes toolchain capabilities, validates environment variables, computes installation and sysroot paths, selects enabled features such as LTO, plugins, PIE, sanitizer- and target-specific defaults, and emits configured outputs like Makefiles and auto-host.h. It is the authoritative source for generating the configure script and host configuration headers for the compiler proper.
